description: This Java class 'PolicyConflictStrategy' handles conflict scenarios when attempting to create a new policy that already exists in the system. It extends 'AbstractPolicyCommandStrategy' with logic to generate an error result upon conflict.

classes.name: PolicyConflictStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles cases where creating a policy conflicts with an existing policy. It produces an error result indicating the conflict.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the method to produce an error result when a policy conflict is detected during creation.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous policy entity if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the new policy entity if available.
